about: The one source of the figures the project's site shows (ADO2, #671). Each figure says what it measures, its date (the day or the month of the measure, or, when the source dates no measure, the day the source states it) and its source: a file of the repository, the sentence of it that gives the figure (quote, or several: quotes), and the heading it sits under (anchor) or the run it comes from (run). scripts/adoption.py and tests/unit/test_adoption.py refuse a figure without its date or its source, a source the repository does not hold, a quote its file no longer says, a number of the value, of what it says or of its note that no quote gives, and a figure on a page that is not here. kind: measured, estimate, setting (a value of the code or of its configuration), to-remeasure (a measure taken before the current architecture, to be replayed).

wrong_disruptive.says: isolations and blocks it recommended or made on real traffic (exercises excluded), judged wrong, of those judged, over 30 days

blocked_alone.says: addresses of an SSH brute force that Glorfindel blocked alone, in one weekend, on a bench VM in non_disruptive

quotes: Le week-end du 01/11, bree en `non_disruptive`, Glorfindel a bloqué seul cinq adresses d'un brute force SSH

shadow_contained.says: attacks detected over 30 days that Glorfindel would have contained alone, in observation (it acted on none)

quotes: Glorfindel would have contained 3 of the 5 attacks it detected (shadow)

detect_median.says: median time to detect an attack on the bench, over 30 days

quotes: detection in 107 s and a decision in 2 min (medians)

detect_range.says: time to detect a first attack on the bench, two runs: 20 Oct and 31 Oct

coverage.says: implemented techniques proven over the last 30 days on the bench

source.quote: 4 of the 5 implemented techniques proven in the last 30 days

last_e2e.says: the last run that proved detection and response end to end, on the bench (a technique and a declared fault in one campaign)

source.quote: dernier run de bout en bout : 31/10 (BL1, T1136.001, banc)

proof_flag.says: the age past which the console shows the last proof in red (amber from 21 days)

source.quote: vert sous 21 jours, jaune jusqu'à 30, rouge au-delà ou aucune

model_harness.says: decisions of the harness judged right for the model in service, and one wrong with high confidence

injection_logs.says: decisions diverted by an attacker's instruction planted in a log line (four cases, three draws each, the previous default model)

injection_memory.says: decisions flipped by a memory full of exercises, or by a past cycle that carries an instruction, with the model in service

kill_switch.says: from revoking the injectors' host identity to its first refused call, the attack side's emergency stop (one measure)

source.quote: révocation effective en moins de 3 s (une seule mesure)

fault_mistaken.says: declared fault taken for an attack, on the bench (a single fault so far)

source.quote: une panne prise pour une attaque comptée à part (0 sur 1 au banc)

contain_ransom.says: to contain a ransomware VM, Glorfindel acting alone
contain_ransom.note: a run from before the hosted watch, Orodruin and Dagorlad; to be replayed on the bench

source.quote: ~1 min to contain a ransomware VM

restore_ransom.says: from the detection to the service restored from backup
restore_ransom.note: a run from before the hosted watch, Orodruin and Dagorlad; to be replayed on the bench

quotes: de la détection à la remise en service

hosted_chain.says: from an attack on the bench to its card in Discord, with Glorfindel on Imladris, its own hosted VM

source.quote: chaîne complète jusqu'à Discord en ~2 min

host_cost.says: Imladris, the reference host of Glorfindel, running all the time, before its disk and address

model_cost.says: the model's calls for one attack run on the bench

memory_age.says: the oldest past decision the model is shown from the local memory, and only real ones, never exercises
